_note: Shared canonical-JSON vectors. Team B's packages/core/crypto/canonical.py and Team C's services/audit/app/canonical.py must both reproduce every `canonical` string and `sha256_c` digest below, byte for byte. test_canonical_json.py (C) reads this file.
_provenance: Every digest below was produced by Team C's implementation only. Team B fills `sha256_b` independently at G0; a vector where the two disagree is an integration bug caught at hour 1 instead of hour 18. Do not copy C's digest into B's column.
rules: Keys sorted lexicographically at every depth.
ensure_ascii = False — non-ASCII characters are emitted as UTF-8, never as \uXXXX escapes.
Explicit nulls are preserved; a missing key and a null key must not serialize identically.
Money is integer minor units. A float anywhere in the input raises, never coerces.
Output is encoded UTF-8, then SHA-256'd, then hex-encoded lowercase.
